responsibility: This header declares the gm2 configuration helper that computes the full path to the C preprocessor executable according to GCC installation defaults and frontend options. It is the narrow C interface companion to m2configure.cc for callers that need external tool path resolution during preprocessing setup.
same_name_distinction: This header is the narrow native declaration for m2configure_FullPathCPP used by C/C++ code. Unlike m2configure.def it does not carry the Modula-2 constant/interface form, and unlike m2configure.cc it contains no installation-path computation logic.
